deploy-bot: Production deploy starting for service inference-runtime (us-west-2). Tag: release/v3.5.0 commit d1e2f3a4. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 5m -> 50% for 10m -> full if metrics OK. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Rollout id r-20260320-1 :rocket:
maria: Confirming canary period and rollback plan? ETA on full cutover?
sam: @maria canary 5m automated checks (error rate, p95 latency, CPU). If green we'll shift 50% then 100%. I'll be watching metrics and logs.
leo: Note: autoscaler minReplicas bumped to 4 in this rollout. Keep an eye on pod CPU during ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary started for r-20260320-1 — 5 pods on v3.5.0 (target 50). Initial checks: 200s OK, p95 62ms, error rate <0.1%. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/r-20260320-1
release-bot: Traffic shift to 50% for r-20260320-1 initiated. Canary health OK so far.
sam: Seeing a small 503 spike at ~22:14 for ~30s, hit 0.4% of requests then recovered. No sustained error budget burn.
maria: If that spike persists >5m we revert. Prepped rollback target: release/v3.4.2 (commit b9c8a7).
leo: FYI this rollout flips the model quantization flag on by default — expect ~12% lower token latencies.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 100% -> deployment r-20260320-1 succeeded. Duration 17m. Final commit pinned: d1e2f3a4. :white_check_mark:
maria: Great, I'll update release notes and post customer-facing blurb tomorrow morning.
sam: Marking on-call as monitoring low-priority. I'll follow up with infra summary for the runbook.
release-bot: Promote job completed: tag release/v3.5.0 promoted to prod at 1719087929.
leo: Collected logs for the 503 window: /var/logs/prod/inference-503-20260320.log — saving snapshot to S3 for debugging.
maria: Thanks all. Keeping the changelog pinned and will open a quick PR to docs with the quantization note. :thumbsup:
